record.question:
Write the precis of the following passage, giving it a suitable title:                         (14)
             The FIFA World Cup is the globe’s most prestigious football tournament, held every four
   years by the Fédération Internationale de Football Association (FIFA). Uniting billions of fans and
   national teams, this monumental event transcends sports, serving as a powerful engine for global
   unity, cultural exchange, and international economic growth.
             Often referred to as the “beautiful Game,” football has a universal appeal that requires
   nothing more than a ball and an open space. The World Cup serves as the pinnacle of this sport,
   elevating the passion of local communities onto the international stage. Every four years, it captures
   the attention of a massive global audience, making it the most-watched sporting event on the planet.
   For participating nations, the tournament is a profound source of national pride, where everyday life
   pauses as communities gather to cheer for their country’s color.
            The tournament was first established in 1930 under the vision of then-FIFA President Jules
   Rimet. Since its inaugural competition in Uruguay, the event has grown exponentially in scale and
   competitive intensity. Over the decades, legendary teams and iconic players—such as Pelé, Diego
   Maradona, and Lionel Messi—have etched their names into sports history, creating enduring legacies.
   The event has also adapted to modern demands, integrating advanced technology like Video Assistant
   Referee (VAR) systems to ensure fairness and accuracy in high-stakes matches.
             Beyond the thrill of the matches, the World Cup carries profound socio-economic and
   cultural significance. It acts as a massive cultural melting pot, allowing diverse sets of fans from
   various backgrounds to share traditions, celebrate together, and foster mutual understanding. For the
   host nation, the World Cup is a massive undertaking that brings in billions of dollars through tourism,
   sponsorships, and media rights, while driving infrastructure development like modern stadiums and
   transport networks.
             The FIFA World Cup is more than just a month-long sporting competition; it is a global
   phenomenon that brings humanity together in a shared passion. Despite political and logistical
   challenges, its ability to unite people across borders, languages, and cultures remains unparalleled.
   The tournament leaves a lasting legacy by inspiring generations of young players, cementing national
   identities, and celebrating the sheer joy of the beautiful game.

Time Allowed : 3 hours. Maximum Marks : 100.
